request: Remake the living room in minimalistic style but cozy.

arguments.style_request: Remake the living room in minimalistic style but cozy. A bounded visual confirmation will inspect the actual rendered proposal before delivery; avoid token styling changes or chairs lined up without a useful seating relationship.

reply.message:
I couldn’t create a complete checked preview: the catalog lacks compatible, dimensioned tables and shelving needed for a useful, cozy seating arrangement.

Nothing has changed. The plan is a simple upholstered sofa, quiet rug, reachable lamp and table, and a coordinated focal/storage piece—not lined-up chairs. Other rooms stay untouched. Budget remains unconfirmed; no complete price is available yet.
